blocks.html: In the districts indicated, for developments or enlargements with 25 percent or less of the total floor area of the building allocated to residential uses, for each square foot of a public plaza, subject to the provisions of Section 37-70, provided on a zoning lot, the total floor area permitted on that zoning lot under the provisions of Section 24-11 (Maximum Floor Area Ratio and Percentage of Lot Coverage) may be increased by six square feet.
